scope: versioned benchmark contracts and preregistered experiment surfaces

units.normalized_content: Defines the executable benchmark contract, matched observability/evidence conditions, adversarial controls and source-bounded scoring discipline; benchmark specification is not result evidence.

Defines the benchmark metric family for search/evidence selection, false escalation or assimilation, transfer, repair, search/representation cost and related diagnostics without asserting a canonical natural-intelligence scalar.

v0.1.1 freezes the hostile question whether repeated within-model ambiguity should trigger a model-adequacy probe; it separates evidence selection from interpretation after identical evidence is supplied.
v0.2 freezes model-inadequacy versus noise-compatible uncertainty pairs to test true/false escalation and incremental value beyond a matched history-aware causal reasoner.

v0.3 freezes a representation ablation in which surface prediction/outcome/error statistics are misleading and typed relational history is compared against compressed history and an identically implemented typed-general control.
v0.4 freezes representation repair from raw resolved histories using a supplied generic relation library, explicitly testing relation selection/repair rather than unrestricted operator invention.
v0.5 freezes a single-basis adequacy test and conditional pairwise-AND expansion, charging search/representation cost and distinguishing composition from invention of primitive operators.

v0.6 freezes a hostile pair indistinguishable under every expression in the supplied v0.5 language, testing language-inadequacy diagnosis separately from ordinary unknown/abstention and from operator invention.

v0.7 freezes conditional generic synthesis from terminals t0..t3 and ADD/SUB/GT/LT, comparing always-expand versus collision-gated invocation under identical generator/scoring rules; it explicitly leaves meta-language invention untested.
Experiment records are versioned/preregistered before implementation where possible and are not rewritten after execution; repairs or changed discriminators belong to successor versions.
Preregisters the hostile v0.1 observational-equivalence pair requiring non-guessing and discriminating evidence rather than intervention from absence alone.
Preregisters identical initial states with ordinary and model-disrupting evidence to separate evidence-acquisition policy from post-evidence interpretation.
Freezes four development and four held-out v0.2 cases matched on failure count/probe cost while varying residual structure and true adequacy regime.
Preregisters selective escalation, false-escalation control and the null that matched history-aware causal search may equal or outperform explicit negative-space framing.
Freezes v0.3 training/held-out records so error magnitude and surface similarity are non-identifying while typed relations determine the correct evidence probe.
Preregisters the representation-transfer comparison and a typed-general causal control so any gain from typed structure cannot be assigned to terminology alone.
Freezes acquisition, repair and held-out v0.4 cases with constant error magnitude and surface cues deliberately broken by repair histories.
Preregisters representation change and transfer after failures reveal a previously rewarded surface abstraction as non-transferable; relation primitives remain supplied and paid for by complexity.
Freezes v0.5 cases such that one probe class requires a conjunction while three control classes remain solvable by the supplied single-relation basis.
Preregisters basis inadequacy threshold, conditional composition, always-compose and oracle controls, search/representation costs and the boundary basis composition != primitive invention.
Freezes adequate, hostile language-collision and unsupported-unknown v0.6 cases while retaining raw ordered traces outside the frozen 78-expression current language.
Preregisters discrimination between forced assimilation, ordinary abstention and demonstrated construction-language inadequacy; primary systems are not given replacement trace operators.
Freezes two independent current-language collision families, adequate controls and an unsupported unknown case for v0.7, with held-out traces differing numerically from training traces.

Preregisters finite generic expression synthesis, matched always-expand and boundary-gated systems, candidate-evaluation and representation cost, transfer requirements, and explicit nonclaims about primitive/meta-language invention.
